Talks on MERFISH: “Image-Based Spatial Transcriptomics with smFISH: From Probe Design to Image Analysis” — Jonathan Enriquez (Institut de Génomique Fonctionnelle de Lyon) — in person “Whole-embryo spatiotemporal transcriptomics at subcellular resolution” — Yinan Wan (University of Basel) — online

Programme notes




Except for the opening lecture (delivered in room 0-821), all the classes of the workshop will take place in the Bioinformatics Lab of the Biology Institute, room 7-424
All sessions include breaks to maintain engagement and provide networking opportunities
The Bruker Hive and 10x Genomics/Genetica sponsor presentations are scheduled for 40 minutes each (Thursday 09:00-09:40 and 14:00-14:40); the remaining 20 minutes of each hour are kept as a short break
Konstantin Khodosevich’s session (Wednesday) and Yinan Wan’s talk (Friday) will be delivered online
